post.originalText:
I am not joking when I say this.

Traditional game development is over.

I asked Opus-5.5 to make Attack on Titan in Minecraft. Took ~1hr and cost less than $25 start to finish.

The end result is extremely fun. And multiplayer!

Guide + link to play below. https://t.co/SwqKzRET4D
